name: Ponytail Everywhere
description: Brings lazy-ladder discipline (YAGNI, reuse before writing, stdlib and native features before dependencies, shortest working diff) to GSD as an advisory planner contribution at plan:pre, matching executor and verifier fragments, and a plan-review proportionality checker contribution. An optional Claude Code plugin adds a subagent banner and a pre-expansion check that recommends a smaller route before scope-expanding commands.
author: Dennis A. V. Dittrich

name: SOTA Numerics
description: Advisory steering across the plan, execute, verify and ship lifecycle toward state-of-the-art numerics: internally consistent, project-consistent, unambiguous, complete, efficient, quiet-running, agent-facing code. Adds advisory fragments at plan:pre, execute:wave:pre, execute:wave:post and ship:pre, plus one blocking plan:post gate that requires an Alternatives Considered section with cited, dated alternatives and a Decided by line in every plan.
author: Dennis A. V. Dittrich

name: PR Workflow
description: Reads the open pull request and its checks for the current branch with gh, writes a PR.md report after each execute wave, and advises (never blocks) at ship:pre when the PR is not green. Fails open: a missing or erroring gh yields an unavailable report instead of a stale pass.
author: Dennis A. V. Dittrich

name: Beads Lifecycle
description: Ties gsd-core's plan, execute, verify and ship lifecycle to Beads (bd) issue tracking: syncs PLAN.md tasks into bd issues under a phase epic, recalls open issues that may touch a phase before planning, closes completed tasks' issues after each wave, writes BEADS.md, and blocks /gsd-ship while blocking_open or diverged is not 0. Needs the bd binary; every step degrades to a no-op with a STATE.md note when bd is missing.
author: Dennis A. V. Dittrich
